name: Zhang Yanghao
credit: Traditional portrait drawing of Zhang Yanghao · Public domain (Wikimedia Commons)
bio: Zhang Yanghao (1270–1329), courtesy name Xiyun, was a Yuan official from Jinan who rose to high office as a censor and Hanlin academician, and is counted among the leading writers of sanqu, the Yuan dynasty's tune-based song verse.

In 1329 he was called out of retirement to organise famine relief in Shaanxi, where he died within months. The sanqu on Tongguan, written on that journey, closes on the line that people suffer whether a dynasty rises or falls.

poems.title: 山坡羊 潼關懷古 (Shan po yang · Tong guan huai gu)
poems.author: Zhang Yanghao
poems.text:
峰巒如聚，波濤如怒，山河表裏潼關路。
望西都，意躊躕，傷心秦漢經行處，宮闕萬間都做了土。
興，百姓苦；亡，百姓苦。

poems.title: 山坡羊 驪山懷古 (Shan po yang · Li shan huai gu)
poems.author: Zhang Yanghao
poems.text:
驪山四顧，阿房一炬，
當時奢侈今何處？
只見草蕭疏，水縈紆。
至今遺恨迷煙樹。
列國周齊秦漢楚。
贏，都變做了土；
輸，都變做了土。
